operations.name: Create IOCs
operations.description:
Add an IoC to the Threat Intelligence database.
These values under data are required fields: "source", "type", "value", and "method".
"Type" and "method" must be in upper case.
The "validUntil" field is mandatory, and must contain a date, for example, 2021-03-20 09:14:47.779000. "validUntil" determines when the IOC expires.
If the expiration date ("validUntil") is left blank, by default it will be the upload date plus a default offset value:
- 14 days for IPs
- 90 days for URLs and domains
- 180 days for file hashes (SHA1, SHA256, and MD5)
The maximum offset values allowed are:
- 30 days for IPs
- 180 days for URLs and Domains
- 180 days for hashes (SHA1, SHA256, and MD5)
The upload date is when the API gets a request to create an IOC.
If the expiration date is later than the upload date plus the the maximum offset value allowed, it will be adjusted to the upload date plus the maximum offset value allowed.

responses.description: Success

Unauthorized access - please sign in and retry.

operations.name: Create IOCs from STIX bundle
operations.description:
Add IOCs to the Threat Intelligence database from a STIX 2.1 bundle. The API will transform STIX indicators into Threat Intelligence IOCs.
Must be a valid STIX 2.1 bundle containing indicator objects
Each indicator object should have a valid STIX pattern for one of these types:
-File hashes: [file:hashes.MD5 = ...], [file:hashes.SHA-1 = ...], [file:hashes.SHA-256 = ...]
-IP addresses: [ipv4-addr:value = ...]
-Domains: [domain-name:value = ...]
-URLs: [url:value = ...]
If the expiration date ("validUntil") is left blank, by default it will be the upload date plus a default offset value:
- 14 days for IPs
- 90 days for URLs and domains
- 180 days for file hashes (SHA1, SHA256, and MD5)
The maximum offset values allowed are:
- 30 days for IPs
- 180 days for URLs and Domains
- 180 days for hashes (SHA1, SHA256, and MD5)
The upload date is when the API gets a request to create an IOC.
If the expiration date is later than the upload date plus the the maximum offset value allowed, it will be adjusted to the upload date plus the maximum offset value allowed.
The API will also process these optional STIX relationships if present:
-Threat Actors (names and types)
-Malware names
-Campaign names
-Intrusion Sets
Other stix objects, or indicators with unsupported stix pattern, will be ignored.

operations.name: Get IOCs
operations.description:
Get the IOCs of a specified Account that match the filter.
Note: Using creationTime to sort results has been deprecated and should not be used. In the future, the ability to sort by creationTime will be removed. Please sort by uploadTime or updatedAt as an alternative.

responses.description: Success
Invalid user input received. See error details for further information.
Unauthorized access - please sign in and retry.

query.name: accountIds
query.description: List of Account IDs to filter by. Example: "4,2,6,4,1,8,0,3,0,2,1,2,0,7,3,7,6,2".

query.name: batchId
query.description: Unique ID of the uploaded indicators batch. Example: "atmtn000000028a881bcf939dc6d92ab55443".

query.name: campaignNames__in
query.description: List of campaign names associated with the indicator.

query.name: category__in
query.description: The categories of the Threat Intelligence indicator, e.g.  the malware type associated with the IOC

query.name: countOnly
query.description: If true, only total number of items will be returned, without any of the actual objects.

query.name: creationTime__gt
query.description: Creation Time as set by the user greater than. Example: "2021-07-12T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: creationTime__gte
query.description: Creation Time as set by the user greater or equal than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: creationTime__lt
query.description: Creation Time as set by the user lesser than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: creationTime__lte
query.description: Creation Time as set by the user lesser or equal than. Example: "2021-07-11T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: creator__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the user uploaded the Threat Intelligence indicator (supports multiple values). Example: "admin@sentinelone.com".

query.name: cursor
query.description: Cursor position returned by the last request. Use to iterate over more than 1000 items. Example: "YWdlbnRfaWQ6NTgwMjkzODE=".

query.name: description__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the description of the indicator (supports multiple values). Example: "Malicious-activity".

query.name: externalId
query.description: The unique identifier of the indicator as provided by the Threat Intelligence source. Example: "e277603e-1060-5ad4-9937-c26c97f1ca68".

query.name: labels__in
query.description: List of labels associated with the indicator.

query.name: limit
query.description: Limit number of returned items (1-1000). Example: "10".

query.name: malwareNames__in
query.description: A list of malware names to filter by.

query.name: name__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the Indicator name (supports multiple values). Example: "foo.dll".

query.name: severity
query.description: A list of severities to filter by (0-7)

query.name: siteIds
query.description: List of Site IDs to filter by. Example: "4,2,6,4,1,8,0,3,0,2,1,2,0,7,3,7,6,2".

query.name: skip
query.description: Skip first number of items (0-1000). To iterate over more than 1000 items,  use "cursor". Example: "150".

query.name: skipCount
query.description: If true, total number of items will not be calculated, which speeds up execution time.

query.name: sortBy
query.description: The column to sort the results by. Example: "id".

query.name: sortOrder
query.description: Sort direction. Example: "asc".

query.name: source
query.description: List of the sources of the identified Threat Intelligence indicator. Example: "AlienVault".

query.name: tenant
query.description: Indicates a tenant scope request

query.name: threatActors__in
query.description: A list of threat actors to filter by

query.name: threatActorTypes__in
query.description: List of threat actor types associated with the indicator.

query.name: type
query.description: The type of the Threat Intelligence indicator. Example: "IPv4".

query.name: updatedAt__gt
query.description: The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB  greater than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: updatedAt__gte
query.description: The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB  greater or equal than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: updatedAt__lt
query.description: The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB  lesser than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: updatedAt__lte
query.description: The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB  lesser or equal than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: uploadTime__gt
query.description: The time at which the Threat Intelligence indicator was uploaded to SentinelOne DB greater than. Example: "2022-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".

query.name: uploadTime__gte

query.name: uploadTime__lt

query.name: uploadTime__lte
